features.title: Nyra features
features.description: What Nyra can do besides answering. The ones with a brain use the chosen model, so they take longer and, with a cloud model, cost more.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: Nyra searches when you ask it to or when the question needs recent information, and cites the pages it reads.

compatibleGuides.title: Follow CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
compatibleGuides.description: In a connected folder or a project, Nyra always follows the instructions in its NYRA.md. With this on, it also follows CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, other assistants' files, in the main folder and in the subfolders it works in, with the files they import with @. Where they disagree, NYRA.md wins.

readLinks.title: Read the links you paste
readLinks.description: When you paste a link, Nyra reads the page and attaches it to the message, so the model also has it for your next questions.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Nyra remembers short facts about you across conversations.
memory.modelUse: The model decides what to remember, and memories are used in your messages.

semanticSearch.title: Search folders by meaning
semanticSearch.description: Nyra finds what you are looking for in a connected folder even when it is written with other words or in another language. For example, "where is the user validated" finds "login". The first time, it takes a moment to prepare the folder. It needs an Ollama model for searching folders, such as qwen3-embedding, which you choose in Providers.

runCommands.title: Run commands in folders
runCommands.description: In a connected folder, Nyra can ask to run a command, such as running the tests, building or checking the Git status. Nothing runs until you press "Run" on its card. When this is off, Nyra only reads the folder and proposes changes.

runCode.title: Run code
runCode.description: Nyra can write a short program in Python or JavaScript and run it to calculate exactly, analyze or convert your files or make charts, even without a connected folder. Nothing runs until you press "Run" on its card. It needs Python or Node.js installed on the computer.

browser.title: Use the browser
browser.description: Nyra can open pages in your Chrome, Edge or another Chromium browser to check a page, sign in with the details you give it or take screenshots.

smartTitles.title: Smart titles
smartTitles.description: After the first reply, the model gives each new conversation a short title about its topic. When this is off, the start of your first message is used.

sensitiveData.title: Sensitive data warning
sensitiveData.description: While you write to a cloud provider, Nyra checks the message and its text files on your computer. If it sees something that looks like sensitive information, it points it out next to Send, without stopping you from sending. The check never leaves your computer.

transcription.title: Transcribe audio
transcription.description: When you attach an audio file, Nyra transcribes it with its timings and, if you want, who is speaking. Then you can ask it for a summary or minutes.

screenLook.title: See your screen
screenLook.description: Nyra can look at your screen to help you with an app or a setting: it shows you where things are, guides you step by step or does it for you with the mouse and keyboard. It asks for your permission first. It needs a model that sees images.
